name: FluidGlass-TS-TW
blurb: A 3D glass shape that distorts and refracts content as you scroll and move the cursor.
description: Three.js component rendering a refractive glass geometry (lens, cube, or bar) using transmission materials. The glass follows pointer movement and parallax-scrolls content behind it for a premium, interactive effect.
use_when: You want a striking, high-polish hero that showcases modern 3D design and rewards mouse movement.
avoid_when: Touch-only surfaces, older devices without WebGL support, or when pointer tracking is unavailable.
a11y: Purely visual 3D component; mouse tracking has no keyboard equivalent.
